snippet.title: BABELOMANIA - EARLY ACCESS TRAILER
snippet.description:
Be ready to dive back in the horrors of Bois-le-Dumont... Shigeo Arata has already taken his first step into this wedding turned nightmares, but what happened to the other invitees? What about the groom, Francesco?

What about the bride...?
